# Obadiah Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 339v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/OBA_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-vision [chazon] of-Ovadyah [Obadiah]. Thus says the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH to-Edom [Edom]: A-report [shemuah] we-have-heard from-YHWH, and-a-messenger [tsir] among-the-nations has-been-sent: "Rise-up [qumu]! And-let-us-rise against-her for-battle [milchamah]."

**1:2** "Behold, small [qaton] I-have-made-you among-the-nations; despised [bazui] you [are] exceedingly."

**1:3** "The-presumption [zedon] of-your-heart has-deceived-you [hishi'ekha], [you who] dwell [shokhni] in-the-clefts [chagvei] of-the-rock [sela], [in] the-height [merom] of-his-dwelling [shivto], [who] says in-his-heart, 'Who will-bring-me-down [yorideni] to-earth [arets]?'"

**1:4** "If you-exalt [tagbiha] like-the-eagle [ka-nesher], and-if among the-stars [kokhavim] you-set [sim] your-nest [qinnekha] — from-there I-will-bring-you-down [oridekha]," declares [ne'um] YHWH.

**1:5** "If thieves [gannavim] came to-you, if plunderers [shodedei] of-the-night — how you-have-been-destroyed [nidmeita]! — would-they-not steal [yignevu] only their-enough [dayam]? If grape-gatherers [botsrim] came to-you, would-they-not leave gleanings [olelot]?"

**1:6** "How Esav [Esau] has-been-searched-out [nechpesu], his-hidden-things [matspunav] sought-out [niv'u]!"

**1:7** "To the-border [gvul] they-have-sent-you — all the-men of-your-covenant [beritekha]; they-have-deceived-you [hishi'ukha], they-have-prevailed [yakhlu] against-you, the-men of-your-peace [shelomekha]; your-bread [lachmekha] they-set [yasimu] as-a-snare [mazor] under-you — there-is-no understanding [tevunah] in-him."

**1:8** "Will-I-not in-that day [yom]," declares YHWH, "destroy [ha'avadeti] the-wise [chakhamim] from-Edom and-understanding [tevunah] from-the-mountain of-Esav?"

**1:9** "And-your-mighty-men [gibborekha] shall-be-dismayed [chatu], O-Teman, so-that every-man from-the-mountain of-Esav will-be-cut-off [yikkaret] by-slaughter [mi-qatel]."

**1:10** "Because-of the-violence [chamas] done to-your-brother Yaakov [Jacob], shame [bushah] shall-cover-you, and-you-shall-be-cut-off [nikhrata] forever [le-olam]."

**1:11** "On-the-day [yom] you-stood [amodkha] opposite [mi-neged], on-the-day strangers [zarim] carried-away [shevot] his-wealth [cheilo], and-foreigners [nokhrim] entered [ba'u] his-gates and-over Yerushalayim [Jerusalem] they-cast lots [yaddu goral] — also you [were] like-one of-them."

**1:12** "But-do-not look [al-tere] on-the-day of-your-brother on-the-day of-his-misfortune [nokhro]; and-do-not rejoice [al-tismach] over-the-sons of-Yehudah [Judah] on-the-day of-their-destruction [ovodam]; and-do-not make-large [al-tagdel] your-mouth on-the-day of-distress [tsarah]."

**1:13** "Do-not enter [al-tavo] the-gate of-my-people on-the-day of-their-calamity [eidam]; do-not look [al-tere], also you, on-his-evil [ra'ato] on-the-day of-his-calamity; and-do-not stretch-out [al-tishlachnah] against-his-wealth on-the-day of-his-calamity."

**1:14** "And-do-not stand [al-ta'amod] at the-crossroads [ha-pereq] to-cut-off [lehakhrit] his-escapees [peliytav]; and-do-not hand-over [al-tasger] his-survivors [seridav] on-the-day of-distress."

**1:15** "For near [qarov] is the-day of-YHWH upon all the-nations [goyim]. As you have-done [asita], it-shall-be-done [ye'aseh] to-you; your-dealing [gemulkha] shall-return [yashuv] on-your-head [roshekha]."

**1:16** "For as you-have-drunk [shetitem] upon my-holy [qodshi] mountain, all the-nations shall-drink [yishtu] continually [tamid]; they-shall-drink and-swallow [vela'u] and-shall-be as-though-they-had-not been [ke-lo hayu]."

**1:17** "But-on Mount [har] Tsiyon [Zion] there-shall-be deliverance [peletah], and-it-shall-be holy [qodesh]; and-the-house of-Yaakov shall-possess [yareshu] their-possessions [morashehem]."

**1:18** "And-the-house of-Yaakov shall-be a-fire [esh], and-the-house of-Yosef [Joseph] a-flame [lehavah], and-the-house of-Esav stubble [qash]; and-they-shall-burn [dalqu] them and-consume-them [akhalum], and-there-shall-not be a-survivor [sarid] for-the-house of-Esav," for YHWH has-spoken.

**1:19** And-they-shall-possess [yareshu] the-Negev [south], the-mountain of-Esav, and-the-Shephelah [lowland], the-Philistines [Pelishtim]; and-they-shall-possess the-field [sedeh] of-Efrayim [Ephraim] and-the-field of-Shomron [Samaria]; and-Binyamin [Benjamin] [shall possess] Gil'ad [Gilead].

**1:20** And-the-exiles [galut] of-this-army of-the-sons of-Yisra'el [Israel] who [are among] the-Canaanites [Kena'anim] as-far-as Tsarfat [Zarephath], and-the-exiles of-Yerushalayim who [are] in-Sefarad [Sepharad] shall-possess the-cities of-the-Negev.

**1:21** And-saviors [moshi'im] shall-go-up on-Mount Tsiyon to-judge [lishpot] the-mountain of-Esav; and-the-kingship [ha-melukhah] shall-be YHWH's.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "The vision of Obadiah":** The shortest book in the Hebrew Bible — 21 verses. *Ovadyah* means "servant of YHWH." Nothing else is known about this prophet. The oracle against Edom parallels Jeremiah 49:7-22 closely, suggesting shared source material or direct borrowing.

**v.3 — "clefts of the rock":** *Sela* may refer to the Edomite capital Petra (Greek for "rock"). The Edomites inhabited the mountainous region of Seir, southeast of the Dead Sea, with settlements carved into rock cliffs.

**v.7 — "your bread they set as a snare":** The Hebrew *mazor* is obscure — some read "wound" (from *zarah*), others "snare" or "trap." The MT is difficult; the overall sense is betrayal by allies.

**v.15 — "The day of YHWH":** The pivotal verse — Obadiah transitions from judgment on Edom specifically to the universal "day of YHWH" against all nations. The *lex talionis* principle: as you have done, so it shall be done to you.

**v.20 — "Sepharad":** The location of Sepharad is debated — Sardis in Lydia (most common identification), or possibly a location in Media. Later Jewish tradition identified it with Spain, giving rise to the term "Sephardic."

*— EMET*
